claims: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket successfully launched the Starlink 17-35 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 7:50 p.m. PDT (10:50 p.m. EDT) from Space Launch Complex 4 East.
The Starlink 17-35 mission deployed 25 Starlink satellites to low-Earth orbit.
The Starlink 17-35 mission included a booster landing on a droneship in the Pacific Ocean.
The payload was 25 Starlink V2 Mini satellites.
The launch date was Monday, April 6, 2026.
The launch time was 7:50 p.m. PDT.
The launch location was Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E), Vandenberg SFB, California.
The booster landing was on droneship "Of Course I Still Love You".
A launch scheduled for Sunday, April 5, was scrubbed due to upper-level winds.
The rocket took a southerly trajectory.
The launch was the 22nd launch of 2026 from the Vandenberg Space Force Base.
